memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis flare.
Patient reports worsening scaly plaques on elbows and knees, joint pain and morning stiffness lasting >1 hour. Examination shows erythematous plaques with silvery scale over extensor surfaces, tender swollen wrists and MCP joints. No respiratory symptoms. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.20 L (95% pred), FVC 3.80 L (98% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; unchanged from baseline. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Inhaler technique: no inhaler prescribed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topical to plaques
calcipotriol ointment OD topical to plaques
methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly
folic acid 5 mg PO daily
hydroxychloroquine 200 mg PO daily
prednisolone 5 mg PO daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 38 U/L (≤40), AST 34 U/L (≤40), ALKP 78 U/L (≤120), GGT 32 U/L (≤50), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (≤1.2). CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dL (12-16), WBC 6.2×10⁹/L (4-10), platelets 210×10⁹/L (150-400). Creatinine 0.8 mg/dL (0.6-1.1). ESR 22 mm/hr (≤20). CRP 6 mg/L (≤5). RF 12 IU/mL (<14). anti-CCP 5 U/ml (<20).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Psoriasis improving, rheumatoid arthritis active.
Plaques less erythematous, scaling decreased. Joint tenderness persists in wrists and MCP, morning stiffness 45 min. LFT shows mild ALT rise to 55 U/L. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.18 L (94% pred), FVC 3.78 L (97% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 –0.02 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Inhaler technique: no inhaler prescribed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
methotrexate 5 mg PO once weekly (reduced from 7.5 mg)
folic acid 5 mg PO daily unchanged
other meds unchanged

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-08-10 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Psoriasis well controlled, rheumatoid arthritis stable.
Plaques flat, minimal scale. Joint pain mild, morning stiffness 20 min. LFT normal. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.22 L (96% pred), FVC 3.82 L (99% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 +0.04 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Inhaler technique: no inhaler prescribed.

memories.text: LFT: ALT 30 U/L, AST 28 U/L, ALKP 75 U/L, GGT 30 U/L, bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL. CBC: Hb 13.0 g/dL, WBC 6.0×10⁹/L, platelets 205×10⁹/L. Creatinine 0.8 mg/dL. ESR 18 mm/hr. CRP 4 mg/L. RF 10 IU/mL. anti-CCP 4 U/ml.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Psoriasis mild flare, rheumatoid arthritis worsening.
New plaques on scalp, itching. Joint pain increased in wrists, knees, morning stiffness 70 min. ESR elevated. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.20 L (95% pred), FVC 3.80 L (98% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 –0.02 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Inhaler technique: no inhaler prescribed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 3.25 L (97% pred), FVC 3.85 L (100% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 +0.05 L since last test. No bronchodilator response. Interpretation: normal lung function.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Psoriasis in remission, rheumatoid arthritis controlled.
Plaques clear, no scaling. Joint pain minimal, morning stiffness 10 min. LFT normal. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 3.27 L (98% pred), FVC 3.88 L (101% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; ΔFEV1 +0.02 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Inhaler technique: no inhaler prescribed.
